zoe: Quick shoutout 12 huge thanks to Matt and Facilities for jumping in when the projector and the demo laptop both decided to nap. :raised_hands: :tada:

matt: It was a tiny circus but we got the show on. big props to @facilities for the mystery HDMI dongle and the heroic ladder retrieval. also shout to Anya for keeping the slide deck calm. :clap:

anya: whew. I now officially trust duct tape and kindness. also someone left a box of cookies in the kitchen and morale immediately improved :cookie: (reactions: :heart: x5)

facilities: happy to help! FYI we found the original HDMI in the AV closet labeled "probably important" 12 we'll add better labels tomorrow.

zoe: filing a note on the kudos board. kudosbot: Created kudos card for Matt, Facilities, and Anya. Summary: "AV triage + demo save + mysterious cookie diplomacy." (id: K-387654-01)

lunchbot: Poll: "Thank-you treat for Facilities" 12 React: 1: Donut box, 2: Bento trays, 3: Cookie remix. Poll open 8h.

matt: :two: if Bento then extra pickles pls.

anya: :three: cookie remix sounds on brand.

zoe: thanks again everyone. tiny chaos, huge teamwork. :sparkles:
